explanationMd: Combine the positive radicals to get √(9x²). This equals 3|x|, and x is positive, so the result is 3x. The sign condition permits removing the absolute value.

distractorRationale.d: This retains an unnecessary square after taking the root.
distractorRationale.c: This takes the square factor nine without its square root.
distractorRationale.b: The original variable was squared, so its square root is x for positive x.
distractorRationale.a: This mishandles the ratio of the radicals.
